Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Robert Souder writes:
> according to the old rules on thoughts betrayed where you could not play
> any cards at all would you still be able to play fortitude cards to
> prevent damage seeing how they are played after strike resolution?
> just a quick question.

No.

Before the errata, superior TB prevented the opposing minion from
playing card for the rest of the combat. Not "until after strike
resolution".
